**Evidence**  
*Table 4 – Top 20 local authority districts with the highest proportions of income deprivation (IoD2019)*  

| Rank | Local Authority District | Income deprivation – proportion of population (2019) | Comment |
|------|---------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|---------|
| 1 | Middlesbrough | 25.1 % |   |
| 2 | Knowsley | 25.1 % |   |

| 8 | Manchester | 21.9 % |   |

|10 | Blackburn with Darwen | 21.2 % |   |
|11 | Wolverhampton | 21.1 % |   |
|12 | South Tyneside | 20.6 % |   |
|13 | Burnley | 20.3 % |   |
|14 | Hastings | 20.2 % |   |
|15 | Rochdale | 20.1 % |   |
|16 | Walsall | 20.0 % |   |
|17 | Nottingham | 19.9 % |   |
|18 | Leicester | 19.6 % |  ≤ > 15 % (eligible) |
|19 | Hackney | 19.6 % |   |
|20 | Barking and Dagenham | 19.4 % |   |

*Key text excerpts (quotes)*  
- “**Leicester — 19.6 %**” (Table 4, row 18).  
- “…the 20 local authority districts with the highest proportions of **income deprivation** …” (Table 4 heading).  

**Coverage**  
- The table is a *subset* of all UK local authority districts: it lists only the *top 20* in terms of proportion of income‑deprived population for 2019.  
- It covers the year 2019 (Income Deprivation Domain data).  
- The list includes only local authority districts; it does **not** contain any data on population change, nor does it list local authorities outside the top 20.

**Missing**  
- Population size change between 2011 & 2021 for any local authority (no evidence on this PDF).  
- Status of income deprivation for **Bolsover**, **Ashfield**, **Mansfield**, **Derby** – not present in the table, so evidence is unavailable.  
- Whether those four authorities (or any others) meet the > 15 % threshold.  

**Next links**  
- **https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/populationandmigration/populationestimates/datasets/ons‑2021‑local‑authority‑district‑population‑estimates** → to obtain population estimates for 2021 by local authority; would allow calculation of 2011‑2021 change.  
- **https://imd-bygeo.opendatacommunities.org/imd/2019/area** → to download the full local‑authority‑level deprivation summary table (includes all authorities, enabling confirmation that the four missing authorities are not > 15 %).
